## Recovered observations

46 points (from FA-40) read by two readings made separately and reconciled (batch `curves-appa-b1`, rules `docs/CURVE-READING.md (2026-10-08)`). Values are SI; the printed-unit values and the pixel coordinates on the page image are kept beside them so every point can be checked against the scan. x_read_bound and y_read_bound are reading bounds in printed units: the largest change of value over the point's pixel interval on the piecewise map, plus the location error of the two lines around it (D-025; the global calibration residual is not added, see qa/<batch>/calibration-sensitivity.md for the affine difference); x_bound_si and y_bound_si are the same in SI. They are not standard deviations.

Both readings drawn on the page image (filled circles: Claude's reading; hollow squares: Codex's; bars: pixel bounds; the canonical reading of each panel is named in the batch review). Click to enlarge.

## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: Cross-hatched band 40 to 45 deg, no curve: loose LSM densified under the normal load so no phi vs Dr curve could be drawn (A-79; A-88). Band drawn across Dr 0 to 1.0 although the text limits it to Dr .40 to 1.00. Same band as FC-21 without the markers. Text phi: soil 10 about 42; soil 11 about 38.3 (outside the band; Table 2-3 42). Reprinted under soil 11.
- Codex: Estimated 40 to 45 degree scatter band; no mean curve. Text limits interpretation to Dr .40 to 1.00 although band spans plot. A-84 gives 38.3 degrees for soil 11. Geometry and rate missing. AM-68-1 Vol. II, Fig. A-40, printed A-78, PDF 79
